'''Toadstool stroganoff''' is the meal of the red [[mushroom]]. It heals {{Hp|12}} but poisons the eater for 5 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/red_mushroom_stroganoff.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A raw red mushroom, a [[steak]], dough, a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]] and a [[bowl]]. Obtaining a [[Braised Toadstool|braised toadstool]] unlocks the recipe. The milk bottle's glass bottle isn't returned.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|12}} and gives {{EffectLink|Poison}} I for 5:00, which deals more damage than the food heals. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
